manager_ids.description: QQ sender IDs allowed to manage persistent group memory.

short_term_max_records.description: Maximum recent conversational records kept for each allowlisted group.

short_term_days.description: Days that ordinary conversational records remain in short-term memory.

long_term_max_memories_per_group.description: Maximum learned preferences and habits kept for one group.

long_term_max_age_days.description: Hard maximum age for a long-term memory before it is forgotten.

long_term_half_life_days.description: Half-life used for gradual long-term memory strength decay.

long_term_min_strength_percent.description: Decayed long-term memories below this strength are forgotten after the initial grace period.

long_term_recall_boost_percent.description: Strength restored when a long-term memory is naturally recalled.

long_term_recall_cooldown_hours.description: Minimum interval before another recall can reinforce the same memory.

long_term_relevant_memories.description: Maximum topic-relevant long-term memories injected per request.

long_term_personal_memories.description: Maximum learned preferences for the current member injected per request.

long_term_injected_chars.description: Maximum long-term memory characters injected per request.

forget_negative_messages.description: Do not retain harassment, hostility, transient negative emotions, or grudge-like replies.

drop_ambiguous_native_context.description: Exclude legacy group conversation turns that have no stable member identity label.

max_message_chars.description: Maximum characters stored from each group message or bot reply.

max_relevant_records.description: Maximum relevant historical records injected into each LLM request.

recent_records.description: Number of recent group records injected for conversational continuity.

personal_records.description: Number of recent records involving the current member injected alongside shared group context.

max_roster_members.description: Maximum recently observed group members included in the nickname roster.

max_injected_chars.description: Maximum persistent-memory characters injected into each LLM request.
